name: は: the topic
explanation: は (read わ) marks what you're talking about, and です ends the sentence politely: N1 is N2. わたしは {学生|がくせい}です: I am a student.

name: じゃありません: is not
pattern: N1 は N2 じゃありません
explanation: The negative of です. ではありません means the same and sounds a little more formal.

name: か: asking a question
pattern: N1 は N2 ですか
explanation: か at the end turns a sentence into a question. Answer はい、〜です or いいえ、〜じゃありません.

name: も: also
explanation: も means also, and it takes the place of は: リーさんも {学生|がくせい}です, Lee is a student too.

name: の: joining two nouns
explanation: の joins two nouns, and the first one tells you more about the second: さくら{大学|だいがく}の {学生|がくせい}, a student at Sakura University.

name: だれ, なんさい: who and how old
pattern: だれですか / なんさいですか
explanation: だれ asks who and なんさい asks someone's age. どなた and おいくつ are the polite versions. Answer with the name or the age, not はい.

name: さん: other people's names
explanation: Put さん after other people's names to be polite. Never put it after your own name.

name: から: where you're from
explanation: から marks where something comes from: タイから {来|き}ました, I'm from Thailand.

name: これ, それ, あれ: this and that
pattern: これ / それ / あれ は N です
explanation: これ is near me, それ is near you, and あれ is far from both of us. If someone asks about それ, answer with これ.

name: この, その, あの: this book, that person
pattern: この / その / あの + N
explanation: The same three, but they sit right before a noun: この {本|ほん}, this book. これ stands on its own.

name: の: whose and what about
pattern: わたしの N / コンピューターの N
explanation: の shows the owner (わたしの {本|ほん}, my book) or what a thing is about (コンピューターの {本|ほん}, a computer book). The noun after の can drop: わたしのです.

name: なん, だれの: what and whose
pattern: なんですか / なんの N / だれの N
explanation: なん asks what a thing is, なんの asks what kind, and だれの asks whose.

name: そうです: that's right
pattern: はい、そうです / いいえ、ちがいます
explanation: そうです agrees with what was said. いいえ goes with ちがいます, that's wrong.

name: A ですか、B ですか: either-or
pattern: A ですか、B ですか
explanation: An either-or question puts か after each choice. Answer with the choice and です, not はい or いいえ.

name: ここ, そこ, あそこ: places
pattern: ここ / そこ / あそこ は N です
explanation: Places: here, there by you, and over there. こちら, そちら and あちら are the polite versions.

name: どこ, どちら: where
pattern: N は どこですか
explanation: どこ asks where, and どちら is the polite version. お{国|くに}は どちらですか asks which country someone is from. Use は before どこですか.

name: の: made in
explanation: の can show where a thing is from or made: {日本|にほん}の くるま, a Japanese car. どこの asks where it's from.

name: いくら: how much
pattern: N は いくらですか
explanation: いくら asks the price. Answer with the amount and {円|えん}: 500{円|えん}です.

name: Numbers that change sound
pattern: さんびゃく / はっせん / さんがい
explanation: Some numbers change sound when they join: 300 is さんびゃく, 8,000 is はっせん, the 3rd floor is さんがい. なんがい asks which floor.

name: 〜じ〜ふん: telling the time
explanation: なんじ asks the time. Watch the readings: 4{時|じ} よじ, 7{時|じ} しちじ, 9{時|じ} くじ, 10{分|ぷん} じゅっぷん. {午前|ごぜん} is a.m. and {午後|ごご} is p.m.

name: ます forms: do, don't, did, didn't
pattern: 〜ます / 〜ません / 〜ました / 〜ませんでした
explanation: Polite verbs change their ending for the negative and the past. A past question needs a past answer.

name: に: at a time
explanation: に marks the time something happens: 6{時|じ}に {起|お}きます, I get up at 6.

name: から, まで: from and until
explanation: から marks the start and まで marks the end: 9{時|じ}から 5{時|じ}まで, from 9 until 5.

name: と: and
explanation: と joins nouns: {土曜日|どようび}と {日曜日|にちようび}, Saturday and Sunday.

name: ね: sharing a feeling
explanation: ね at the end shares a feeling and invites the listener to agree.

name: へ: going somewhere
explanation: へ (read え) marks where you're heading with {行|い}きます, {来|き}ます and {帰|かえ}ります. に works too.

name: で: by train, by bus
pattern: {電車|でんしゃ}で {行|い}きます
explanation: で marks how you travel. なんで asks how. On foot is {歩|ある}いて, with no で.

name: と: with someone
pattern: {友達|ともだち}と {行|い}きます
explanation: と marks who you do something with, and だれと asks who with. {一人|ひとり}で means alone.

name: いつ and dates
explanation: いつ asks when. Some dates have their own readings: the 1st is ついたち, the 8th is ようか, and April is しがつ.

name: どこも + negative: nowhere
pattern: どこ(へ)も {行|い}きません
explanation: A question word with も and a negative verb means not anywhere, or nothing at all.

name: よ: telling someone
explanation: よ at the end tells the listener something they don't know yet.

name: を: the thing you act on
explanation: を marks the thing an action is done to: パンを {食|た}べます, I eat bread. Sports and activities take を with します.

name: で: where it happens
explanation: で marks the place where an action happens: {図書館|としょかん}で {勉強|べんきょう}します. へ is where you go, で is where you do it.

name: なにを: what will you do
explanation: なにを asks what you'll do or what thing. Answer with the thing and を.

name: に: meeting someone
explanation: {会|あ}います takes に (or と) for the person you meet.

name: ませんか, ましょう: inviting
explanation: ませんか invites someone politely: won't you...? ましょう means let's. Say yes with ええ、〜ましょう.

name: そうですか: oh, I see
explanation: With a falling tone, そうですか means oh, I see. It shows you heard something new.
